mapper.select: SELECT MAX(source_month) FROM ( SELECT MAX(stat_month) AS source_month FROM amz_monthly_order_profit UNION ALL SELECT MAX(stat_month) AS source_month FROM ebay_monthly_performance_profit ) source_months

SELECT id AS id, stat_month AS statMonth, principal_name AS principalNames, gross_profit AS grossProfit, net_sales_amount AS netSalesAmount, update_time AS updateTime FROM combined_performance_ranking WHERE stat_month =
#{statMonth}
(SELECT MAX(x.stat_month) FROM combined_performance_ranking x)
AND principal_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{principalName}, '%')
ORDER BY gross_profit DESC, net_sales_amount DESC, id
